4243.title: Launcher replaces the thread server destination
4243.rootCauseOneLine: Managed launcher URL resolution selects saved configuration before the injected thread proxy URL.
4243.proposedFix: Define thread-proxy precedence without globally reversing the existing managed-launch policy; verify authenticated routing.
4243.caveats: URL precedence reproduced twice. Live Connect migration and HTTP 401 were not exercised. No automatic PR because resolving precedence requires a product-policy decision.
